method: exploratory supplemental technical audit; no human experienced-difficulty validation

sudokuEquivalence.legalTransformations: digit permutation; any row permutation within each 3-row band and 3-band permutation; any column permutation within 3-column stacks and stack permutation; transpose
sudokuEquivalence.method: given-board colored constraint graph, 6-iteration Weisfeiler–Lehman hash, compare isomorphism inside hash buckets; no bucket with more than one puzzle
sudokuEquivalence.note: Only equivalent visible givens under Sudoku constraint group, not equivalent solution strategy.

takuzuEquivalence.legalTransformations: 8 square dihedral symmetries and global binary a/b inversion; given cells preserved

continuous20.scope: 20 previously fixed Lv5 playtest cases per each of ten games; NOT observed human repeated play nor actual random play ordering
continuous20.note: selected fingerprints use game-specific coarse saved proxies, not perceptual or solver-equivalence classes; categories are exploratory
continuous20.randomBaseline: 5000 pseudorandom draws of 20 distinct pool positions per game, fixed Python random seed; baseline is descriptive not a hypothesis test of human enjoyment
continuous20.limitation: A complete solver sequence differs from the subjective sequence of decisions and can vary with deterministic solver ordering. 'No repeats' is not supported.

waterSortShortestPathChoices.sample: Five preregistered representative problem IDs per level from issue660 trial manifest; compare with saved optimal move count
waterSortShortestPathChoices.independentAStar: same legal pour rules, distinct states up to bottle permutation, admissible h=number of color runs minus color count; each alternative capped to 0.7s
waterSortShortestPathChoices.limitation: A* samples one shortest solution route, not the entire shortest-solution DAG. 29 moves produce dead-end states with no continuation to a clear state, which the game allows players to undo. Immediate block count is a solver proxy, not human perception.
waterSortShortestPathChoices.independentProofLimit: Four low-color level3 dead-end successors validated via separate BFS enumeration to exhaustion; other 25 are concluded unsolvable by the original A* implementation, which finished without a goal. No timeouts in this dataset.
waterSortShortestPathChoices.undoSemantics: Unsolvable continuation can be recovered by pressing the in-game Undo control; it is not irreversible damage to the session.

sources: Full raw results and one-off scripts in issue660-endgame-research.zip (conversation artifact); committed repository report is an indexed summary, not a new permanent solver.
humanStudy: not performed; no independent experienced participants available in current tools
